scenes.title: Morning Reel
scenes.voiceover: Good morning. Here is your brief for Monday, September 14.

scenes.title: Small model matches big ones on code repair
scenes.voiceover: A new paper shows that a small model can repair code as well as much larger ones. The 3 billion parameter model was fine-tuned on execution traces and matched 30 billion parameter models on the benchmark.

scenes.title: Floods force thousands from homes
bullets: Rivers burst banks in Austria and Czechia
scenes.voiceover: In central Europe, heavy rain has pushed rivers over their banks in Austria and Czechia. Thousands of people have been evacuated from their homes as the water keeps rising in several regions today.

scenes.title: New metro line opens in Pune
scenes.voiceover: Pune has a new metro line. The 12 kilometre route links the airport with the city centre, and it is expected to carry around 200000 passengers every day once it is running.

scenes.title: That's your brief
scenes.voiceover: That is all for this morning. Sources are in your feed.
